entities.summary: Hans Ulrich von Schaffgotsch was a Silesian nobleman and Generalfeldwachtmeister who fought in the Silesian front of the Thirty Years' War. He was falsely convicted of treason and executed following a purge within the army of the Holy Roman Empire that targeted officers associated with former Generalissimo Albrecht von Wallenstein. Hans Ulrich von Schaffgotsch was a military leaders & commanders from Gryf Castle (1595-08-28, Gryf Castle–1635-07-23).
